column_description: Name of the scene. may be NULL.
Description of the scene. may be NULL.
Date and time the scene was created. may be NULL.
Date and time the scene was last updated. may be NULL.
Type of the scene (e.g., indoor, outdoor, action). always exactly one of 'indoor', 'outdoor', 'action'. may be NULL.
Status of the scene (e.g., draft, in progress, completed). always exactly one of 'draft', 'in progress', 'completed'. may be NULL.
ID of the user who created the scene. may be NULL.
ID of the user who last updated the scene. may be NULL.
Flag to indicate if the scene is active. may be NULL.
